about_the_game:
🔷 Never Let Go Buddy – Climb Higher. Fall Harder. Laugh Louder.

Thrown out by his family for being "too much of a burden" (harsh, right?), our wheelchair-bound hero finds an unexpected strength—his pickaxe, his persistence, and a handful of equally unstable friends tied to him by a rope.

Never Let Go Buddy is a chaotic, physics-driven co-op climbing game where you're literally strapped to your friends. Think emotional damage meets slapstick disaster.

🎮 Key Features:

🔗 Tied Together, Forever: You're physically connected to your teammates. If one falls, everyone pays the price. Teamwork is everything.

🧠 Skill + Laughter: Physics-based controls mean you'll fumble, tumble, and occasionally fly—but never without a laugh.

🧗‍♂️ Climb Anything: Rooftops, rusty pipes, collapsing structures, giant sawblades—every object is part of the playground.

🧑‍🤝‍🧑 Online Co-op (1–6 Players): Experience the madness with friends. Or try it solo for the ultimate test of patience and persistence.

🏙️ Themed Levels: Explore diverse environments—from urban rooftops and deserts to and floating islands.

❤️ Emotional Backdrop: Beneath the laughter lies a story of abandonment, resilience, and unlikely friendship. You’ll start from being pushed away… but rise with the help of others.

🎯 Who’s This For?

If rage, gravity, and questionable friendships had a baby—it would be this game. Never Let Go Buddy is here to ruin your life and fix it at the same time.
